query:
UPDATE products
        SET sku         = COALESCE($2, sku),
            name        = COALESCE($3, name),
            description = COALESCE($4, description),
            price       = COALESCE($5, price),
            min_stock   = COALESCE($6, min_stock),
            is_active   = COALESCE($7, is_active)
        WHERE id = $1
